compiled_state.title: As a Jira-side reviewer, descriptions on Jira-imported tickets contain the issue's text content via ADF-to-text flattening
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Add an _adf_to_text helper in bridge/_inbound_api.py and replace the isinstance(_raw_desc, str) branch (lines 237-240) so Jira REST v3 ADF JSON descriptions flatten to plain text instead of becoming None.

**Why**: Jira REST v3 returns description as an ADF (Atlassian Document Format) JSON dict, not a string. The current isinstance(str) check fails, jira_description becomes None, and Jira-imported tickets land locally with empty descriptions. Outbound has _text_to_adf (asymmetric); the symmetric inbound helper does not exist (verified zero matches).

**Scope**:
- IN: _adf_to_text helper (recursive walk over doc → content[paragraph|heading|listItem] → content[text].text joining with newlines), replacement of the isinstance check with the new helper, unit tests with representative ADF fixtures.
- OUT: ADF format-fidelity (preserving links, mentions, panels, mediaSingle) — deferred to follow-on epic per scrutiny rejection of finding #8. No sidecar desc_raw_adf field, no outbound-skip-on-inbound-derived, no BRIDGE_ALERT for unsupported nodes.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, _adf_to_text(adf_dict) flattens a multi-paragraph ADF document to text containing the paragraphs joined by newlines — verified by unit test with a 3-paragraph ADF fixture ← Satisfies: "Jira-originated tickets imported via the inbound bridge preserve their description text through the plain isinstance fix"
- When this story is complete, an inbound CREATE event for a Jira issue with a multi-paragraph text description writes a non-empty desc field on the local ticket (no longer None) — verified by integration test with mocked Jira REST v3 GET returning ADF ← Satisfies: same SC
- When this story is complete, ADF nodes the helper does not handle (panels, mediaSingle, embeds, mentions, inlineCard) are silently skipped — text-bearing nodes are joined; non-text nodes are dropped without raising — explicitly NO BRIDGE_ALERT (deferred to follow-on epic) ← Satisfies: scoped exclusion from epic context
- When this story is complete, unit tests cover (a) plain string input (back-compat), (b) ADF dict with paragraphs only, (c) ADF dict with unsupported nodes mixed with paragraphs, (d) None input, (e) empty string input ← Satisfies: TDD DoD for code-change story

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] The helper signature must accept Union[str, dict, None] and return a str (empty string for None/empty input) — keeping the call-site change minimal at lines 237-240.
- [Testing] ADF fixtures should be derived from a real Jira REST v3 GET response (curl against a sandbox issue) so the test asserts the actual production schema, not a contrived fixture.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
